params.prompt: Educational animation reference diagram, clean black line art on white. Title at top: "The Still Holds a REST Pose". TWO panels side by side. LEFT panel headed "MID-ACTION — wrong" with a red X: a cartoon character frozen mid-throw, arm cocked all the way back, one foot off the ground, clearly an instant rather than a position. Caption: "an instant. The motion must either repeat it or undo it.". RIGHT panel headed "AT REST — correct" with a green check: the same character standing upright and settled, arms hanging at its sides, both feet flat, holding a ball loosely in one hand, turned three-quarters toward the viewer and looking off to one side at its target. Caption: "a position. The motion starts from here.". A dividing note between them: "Held is not the same as transient — hands resting on a keyboard is a position, a hand pressing something onto a wall is an instant.". No other text.
